reason: Term defined one way for Secretary of Treasury reference, another way (similarly construed) for any other official.
ocaml:
let meaning_of_delegate (ref_official : official) : delegate =
  if refers_to_secretary_of_treasury ref_official then
    (* 7701(a)(12)(A)(i) : officer, employee, or agency of Treasury Department duly authorized by Secretary, directly or via redelegation, to perform function *)
    delegate_of_secretary ref_official
  else
    (* 7701(a)(12)(A)(ii) : similarly construed for any other US official *)
    delegate_of_other_official ref_official

reason: Term delegate takes general meaning from child (A) except in Guam/American Samoa performance context for chapters 1,2,21 taxes, where leaf (B) extends it to other duly authorized officials.
ocaml:
let meaning_of_delegate_for_functions (ref_official : official) (context : delegation_context) : delegate =
  if is_guam_or_american_samoa_function context && applies_to_chapters_1_2_21 context then
    (* 7701(a)(12)(B) : term also includes any officer or employee of any other US department or agency, or of any possession, duly authorized by Secretary (directly or via one or more redelegations of authority) to perform such functions *)
    delegate_of_other_department_or_agency_or_possession ref_official
  else
    meaning_of_delegate ref_official
